source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Chapter 19 (PDF 137-155), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a nuclide? What do A and Z stand for in its symbol?
(Nuclide kya hai? Is ke symbol mein A aur Z kya zahir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Symbol ᴬ_Z X se zahir kiya gaya nucleus nuclide kehlata hai. X chemical symbol, Z atomic (charge) number yani protons ki tadaad, aur A mass number yani nucleons (protons + neutrons) ki kul tadaad hai. Neutrons N = A − Z.

book_ref.quote: An atomic nucleus is represented by the symbol

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the numbers of protons and neutrons in ²³⁹₉₄Pu.
(²³⁹₉₄Pu mein protons aur neutrons ki tadaad maloom karein.)
blocks.explanation: Protons = Z = 94. Neutrons N = A − Z = 239 − 94 = 145.

book_ref.quote: The number of neutrons 'N' in the nucleus is given by A-Z.

blocks.prompt:
3 Compare the size of the nucleus with the size of the atom.
(Nucleus aur atom ke size ka muwazna karein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus ka radius 10⁻¹⁴ m aur atom (electrons ke badal samet) ka radius 10⁻¹⁰ m ke darje ka hai. Atom ka radius taqreeban 10⁴ guna bara hai; nucleus bohat chhota aur bohat ghana (dense) hai.

book_ref.quote: surrounded by a cloud of elections giving the atomic radius of the order 10⁻¹⁰ m

blocks.prompt:
4 Define mass defect and write its equation.
(Mass defect ki definition aur equation likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus ka mass us ke protons aur neutrons ke kul mass se hamesha kam hota hai; yeh gum shuda mass, mass defect hai: Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus.

book_ref.quote: The lost or missing mass is called mass defect

blocks.prompt:
5 Define binding energy of a nucleus. How is it related to mass defect?
(Nucleus ki binding energy ki definition likhein. Is ka mass defect se kya taluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Binding energy woh kaam hai jo nucleus ko us ke neutrons aur protons mein todne ke liye karna parta hai. Mass defect Einstein ke relation ΔE = (Δm)c² se is energy mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: this energy is the potential energy called the Binding Energy

blocks.prompt:
6 Why is binding energy considered to have a negative value?
(Binding energy ko negative kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Absolute gravitational potential ki tarah, jo infinity par zero liya jata hai, bandhe hue nucleus ki energy alag nucleons se kam hoti hai; alag karne ke liye energy deni parti hai, is liye binding energy negative li jati hai.

book_ref.quote: Binding energy is considered to have negative value

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho ke alag alag nucleons ki energy zero hai. Jab woh jur kar nucleus banate hain to energy bahar nikalti hai, is liye nucleus ki energy zero se neeche, yani negative, ho jati hai. Wapis alag karne ke liye utni hi energy deni parti hai.

blocks.prompt:
7 What is binding energy per nucleon? Why is it a better measure than total binding energy?
(Binding energy per nucleon kya hai? Yeh kul binding energy se behtar paimana kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Binding energy ko nucleons A se taqseem karne par binding energy per nucleon milti hai: har nucleon ko alag karne ki ausat energy. Is se mukhtalif size ke nuclei ki stability ka muwazna ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: A better measure is the building energy per nucleon.

blocks.prompt:
8 Define the atomic mass unit and give its value in kg.
(Atomic mass unit ki definition likhein aur kg mein qeemat dein.)
blocks.explanation: 1 u carbon-12 ke aik atom ke mass ka 1/12 hai. 1 u = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁴ g = 1.66 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.

book_ref.quote: 1 u is one-twelfth (1/12) of the mass of an atom of carbon-12

blocks.prompt:
9 The mass of a tritium nucleus (1 proton, 2 neutrons) is 5.007357 × 10⁻²⁷ kg. Find its mass defect, using mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg and mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg.
(Tritium nucleus (1 proton, 2 neutrons) ka mass 5.007357 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai. mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg aur mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg le kar mass defect nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Find the mass defect and binding energy of the helium nucleus given that

blocks.prompt:
10 A nucleus has a mass defect of 2.0 × 10⁻²⁹ kg. Find its binding energy in MeV (c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).
(Aik nucleus ka mass defect 2.0 × 10⁻²⁹ kg hai. Binding energy MeV mein nikalein (c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹, 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)

book_ref.quote: Using Einstein's Equation: B.E = Δmc²

blocks.prompt:
11 Where does the mass defect of a nucleus go?
(Nucleus ka mass defect kahan jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus bante waqt gum shuda mass energy mein badal jata hai. Yeh energy ΔE = (Δm)c² binding energy hai; nucleus todne ke liye itni hi energy deni parti hai.

book_ref.quote: The missing mass is converted to energy, used in the formation of the nucleus.

blocks.prompt:
12 What information is given by the position of a nucleus on the binding energy per nucleon curve?
(Binding energy per nucleon curve par nucleus ki jagah kya maloomat deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh batati hai ke nucleus kitna stable hai (zyada binding energy per nucleon, zyada mazboot bandhan) aur us se fission (bohat bhaari) ya fusion (bohat halke) se energy mil sakti hai ya nahi.

book_ref.quote: The position of a nucleus on this curve gives information about the stability of the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
13 Which nuclide is the most stable? What is its binding energy per nucleon?
(Sab se stable nuclide kaunsa hai? Is ki binding energy per nucleon kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Iron-56 (⁵⁶₂₆Fe) sab se stable nuclide hai; curve wahan taqreeban 8.7 MeV per nucleon ki chouti par hai. Sab se stable ilaqa A = 50 se 80 hai.

book_ref.quote: which is the most stable nuclide

blocks.prompt:
14 Why can energy be obtained both by splitting heavy nuclei and by joining light nuclei?
(Bhaari nuclei todne aur halke nuclei jorne, dono se energy kyun milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat halke aur bohat bhaari nuclei ki binding energy per nucleon kam hai. Bhaari ko todne (fission) ya halke ko jorne (fusion) se products ki binding energy per nucleon barhti hai, aur jab bhi yeh barhe energy milti hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus binding energy per nucleon is less for very light and very heavy nuclei.

blocks.prompt:
15 Why is the binding energy of the ordinary hydrogen nucleus zero?
(Aam hydrogen nucleus ki binding energy zero kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam hydrogen nucleus sirf aik proton hai. Bandhne ke liye koi aur nucleon nahi, is liye mass defect nahi aur binding energy zero hai.

book_ref.quote: initially the hydrogen nucleus with just one proton has a binding energy zero

blocks.prompt:
16 Define nuclear fission and write a fission reaction of uranium-235.
(Nuclear fission ki definition likhein aur uranium-235 ki fission reaction likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Fission woh reaction hai jis mein uranium jaisa bhaari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot-ta hai aur energy nikalti hai. ²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴¹₅₆Ba + ⁹²₃₆Kr + 3¹₀n + Q.

book_ref.quote: A reaction in which a heavy nucleus like that of uranium splits up into two nuclei of roughly equal size

blocks.prompt:
17 In what two ways is fission different from other nuclear reactions?
(Fission doosri nuclear reactions se kin do tareeqon se mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehla, uranium nucleus barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot-ta hai, jabke doosri reactions mein reactants aur products ke mass mein kam farq hota hai. Doosra, bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: This nuclear reaction was different from other nuclear reactions, in two ways:

blocks.prompt:
18 Use the binding energy curve to estimate the energy released in the fission of a uranium-235 nucleus.
(Binding energy curve se uranium-235 ke fission ki energy ka andaza lagayein.)
blocks.explanation: Uranium ~7.6 MeV per nucleon; barium aur krypton ~8.5 MeV per nucleon. Har nucleon par 0.9 MeV, 235 nucleons ke liye 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV, yani taqreeban 200 MeV.

book_ref.quote: This means that an energy 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV is given out

blocks.prompt:
19 About 200 MeV is released per fission. Express this energy in joules (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).
(Har fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV nikalti hai. Ise joules mein likhein (1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J).)

book_ref.quote: in the fission of one uranium nucleus, about 200 MeV energy is given out

blocks.prompt:
20 Check that the fission reaction ²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴⁰₅₄Xe + ⁹⁴₃₈Sr + 2¹₀n is balanced.
(Check karein ke fission reaction ²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴⁰₅₄Xe + ⁹⁴₃₈Sr + 2¹₀n balanced hai.)
blocks.explanation: Mass numbers: baayen 236, daayen 140 + 94 + 2 = 236. Charge numbers: baayen 92, daayen 54 + 38 = 92. Dono barabar hain, equation balanced hai.

book_ref.quote: It may be kept in mind that there is no difference between the sum of the mass and the charge numbers

blocks.prompt:
21 Are the fission fragments of uranium always the same? Are they stable?
(Kya uranium ke fission fragments hamesha aik jaise hote hain? Kya woh stable hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Fission hamesha aik jaise tukre nahi deta; Ba + Kr, Sn + Mo ya Xe + Sr ban sakte hain. Yeh tamam fragments radioactive hain.

book_ref.quote: Hence, in the uranium fission reaction, several products may be produced.

blocks.prompt:
22 What is a fission chain reaction?
(Fission chain reaction kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Uranium-235 neutron jazb kar ke toot-ta hai aur do ya teen neutrons nikalta hai. Agar yeh neutrons mazeed nuclei ka fission karein to reaction khud jaari rehta hai; yeh fission chain reaction hai.

book_ref.quote: This process is called fission chain reaction.

blocks.prompt:
23 Define critical mass and critical volume.
(Critical mass aur critical volume ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Critical mass uranium ka woh mass hai jis mein aik fission ke tamam neutrons mein se aik neutron mazeed fission kare. Is mass ka hajm critical volume ya size kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: Such a mass of uranium in which one neutron, out of all the neutrons produced in one fission reaction, produces further fission is called critical mass.

blocks.prompt:
24 Differentiate between a controlled and an uncontrolled chain reaction.
(Controlled aur uncontrolled chain reaction mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Controlled mein har fission ka sirf aik neutron agla fission karta hai; uncontrolled mein zyada tar neutrons fission karte hain.

book_ref.quote: If the mass of uranium is much greater than the critical mass

rows: Har fission ka ausatan aik neutron agla fission karta hai.
Har fission ke zyada tar neutrons mazeed fission karte hain.
Uranium ka mass critical mass ke barabar.
Uranium ka mass critical mass se bohat zyada.
Ibtidai raftar se chalta hai; energy mustaqil raftar se.
Tezi se barhta hai; bara dhamaka.
Atomic reactor mein (cadmium rods zaid neutrons jazb karti hain).
Atom bomb mein.

blocks.prompt:
25 What happens to a chain reaction if the mass of uranium is less than the critical mass?
(Agar uranium ka mass critical mass se kam ho to chain reaction ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chhote mass se bohat se neutrons fission kiye baghair bahar nikal jate hain, is liye chain reaction aage nahi barhta.

book_ref.quote: If the mass of uranium is less than the critical mass, the chain reaction does not proceed.

blocks.prompt:
26 Why does a sufficiently big spherical lump of uranium-235 sustain a chain reaction while a thin sheet does not?
(Uranium-235 ka kaafi bara gol tukra chain reaction kyun jaari rakhta hai jabke patli chadar nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Patli chadar se neutrons hawa mein nikal jate hain. Bare tukre mein zyada tar neutrons bahar nikalne se pehle andar jazb ho kar mazeed fission karte hain.

book_ref.quote: If the lump is sufficiently big

blocks.prompt:
27 How do cadmium rods control the fission chain reaction?
(Cadmium rods fission chain reaction ko kaise qaboo karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cadmium bohat se neutrons jazb karta hai aur khud radioactive nahi banta. Reactor mein dalne par rods neutrons jazb kar ke fission ke liye neutrons kam kar deti hain.

book_ref.quote: they absorb neutrons to cut down on the number of neutrons that are available for the fission process

blocks.prompt:
28 Compare a nuclear power station with a thermal power station.
(Nuclear power station ka thermal power station se muwazna karein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono steam se turbine aur generator chalate hain; farq heat ke zariye mein hai.

book_ref.quote: the reactor plays the same part as does furnace in a thermal power station

rows: Heat reactor mein fission se banti hai.
Heat furnace mein koila ya tel jalane se banti hai.
Reactor furnace ka kaam karta hai.
Furnace heat ka zariya hai.
Fission fragments ki kinetic energy heat banti hai.
Fuel ki chemical energy heat banti hai.
Radioactive waste chhorta hai.
Radioactive waste nahi hota.

blocks.prompt:
29 How is the energy of fission converted into electricity in a nuclear power station?
(Nuclear power station mein fission ki energy bijli mein kaise badalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fission energy fragments ki kinetic energy hoti hai jo takraon se heat banti hai. Heat se steam, steam se turbine, aur turbine se generator chal kar bijli banata hai.

book_ref.quote: their kinetic energy gets transformed in heat energy

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the core of a reactor? What fuels are used in it?
(Reactor ka core kya hai? Is mein kaunse fuel istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Core reactor ka sab se aham hissa hai jahan fuel cylindrical tubes mein hota hai. Fuel: 2.4-3.0% tak enriched uranium-235 (qudrati mein sirf 0.7%); aaj kal plutonium-239 aur uranium-233 bhi.

book_ref.quote: The most important and vital part of a reactor is called core.

blocks.prompt:
31 What is a moderator? Why is it needed in a reactor?
(Moderator kya hai? Reactor mein is ki zaroorat kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Moderator kam atomic weight wala maadda hai (paani ya heavy water) jo fuel rods ke gird hota hai. Fission ke neutrons bohat tez hote hain; moderator unhein slow karta hai kyunke fission ke liye slow neutrons behtar hain.

book_ref.quote: For this purpose, slow neutrons are more useful.

blocks.prompt:
32 What are control rods? How do they work?
(Control rods kya hain? Yeh kaise kaam karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Control rods cadmium ya boron ki hoti hain jo slow (thermal) neutrons zyada jazb karti hain. Inhein core mein andar bahar kar ke neutrons ki tadaad qaboo hoti hai taake ausatan sirf aik neutron agla fission kare.

book_ref.quote: The control rods made of cadmium or boron are moved in or out of the reactor core

blocks.prompt:
33 What is the function of the heat exchanger in a nuclear power station?
(Nuclear power station mein heat exchanger ka kaam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Core ki heat (taqreeban 500 °C) high pressure par paani, heavy water ya kisi aur maa'e se heat exchanger tak jati hai, jahan aam paani se garam steam ban kar turbine chalati hai.

book_ref.quote: To produce steam from this heat, it is transported to heat exchanger

blocks.prompt:
34 What is heavy water?
(Heavy water kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Heavy water mein aam ¹₁H ki jagah ²₁H, yani hydrogen ka bhaari isotope, hota hai. Yeh moderator aur coolant ke tor par istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Heavy water, it may be remembered, is made of

blocks.prompt:
35 Why is the disposal of nuclear waste a serious problem?
(Nuclear waste ko thikane lagana mushkil masla kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Istemal shuda fuel mein shadeed radioactive maadde hote hain jin ki half-life hazaron saal hai; un ki radiations zinda cheezon ke liye bohat nuqsan deh hain. Inhein samandar, mitti, hawa ya peene ke paani mein nahi jane diya ja sakta.

book_ref.quote: The radiations and the particles emitted out of this nuclear waste are very injurious

blocks.prompt:
36 Where is nuclear waste best stored, and why?
(Nuclear waste behtareen tor par kahan rakha jata hai aur kyun?)
blocks.explanation: Purani namak ki kaanon ki tah mein jo bohat khushk aur hazaron meter gehri hain. Wahan waste mahol ko aloodah kiye baghair decay hota rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Here, they can remain and decay without polluting the environment on the surface of the Earth.

blocks.prompt:
37 Define nuclear fusion and give one fusion reaction.
(Nuclear fusion ki definition likhein aur aik fusion reaction dein.)
blocks.explanation: Fusion woh reaction hai jis mein do halke nuclei mil kar bhaari nucleus banate hain; kuch mass khatam ho kar energy ban jata hai. ²₁H + ³₁H → ⁴₂He + ¹₀n + 17.6 MeV.

book_ref.quote: A nuclear reaction in which two light nuclei merge to form a heavy nucleus is called fusion reaction.

blocks.prompt:
38 Why is a fusion reaction difficult to start?
(Fusion reaction shuru karna mushkil kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dono nuclei positive hain. Unhein bohat qareeb lane ke liye electrostatic repulsion ke khilaf kaam karna parta hai, is liye bohat zyada energy (taqreeban 10 million °C) chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Two positively charged nuclei must be brought very close to one another.

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between nuclear fission and nuclear fusion.
(Nuclear fission aur nuclear fusion mein farq bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation: Fission bhaari nucleus todta hai; fusion halke nuclei jorta hai.

book_ref.quote: In a fusion reaction, more energy per nucleon can be obtained as compared to the fission reaction.

rows: Bhaari nucleus barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot-ta hai.
Do halke nuclei mil kar bhaari nucleus banate hain.
Slow neutrons se shuru hota hai.
Bohat zyada temperature (taqreeban 10 million °C) chahiye.
Taqreeban 0.9 MeV per nucleon (har fission ~200 MeV).
Zyada energy per nucleon, maslan 5 nucleons se 17.6 MeV.
Reactors mein qaboo kar ke bijli banti hai.
Abhi qaboo mein nahi; Suraj aur sitaron mein hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
40 What is a thermonuclear reaction?
(Thermonuclear reaction kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Temperature barhne se atoms ki raftar barhti hai. Taqreeban 10 million °C par halke nuclei itne tez ho jate hain ke mil sakein; itne zyada temperature par hone wali fusion thermonuclear reaction kehlati hai.

book_ref.quote: At such extraordinarily high temperature, the reaction that takes place is called thermonuclear reaction.

blocks.prompt:
41 Calculate the energy per nucleon in the reaction ²₁H + ²₁H → ³₂He + ¹₀n + 3.3 MeV.
(Reaction ²₁H + ²₁H → ³₂He + ¹₀n + 3.3 MeV mein energy per nucleon nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Nucleons = 4. Energy per nucleon = 3.3 / 4 ≈ 0.83 MeV, fission ke 0.9 MeV ke qareeb.

book_ref.quote: In both of these reactions, about 1.0 MeV energy per nucleon is produced

blocks.prompt:
42 Why is fusion not yet used to produce electricity? Where does it take place naturally?
(Fusion abhi bijli banane mein kyun istemal nahi hota? Qudrati tor par kahan hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fusion ko abhi tak fission ki tarah qaboo nahi kiya gaya (sirf atom bomb se shuru hone wale hydrogen bomb ke test mein dekha gaya), is liye bijli nahi banti. Qudrati tor par sitaron, Suraj samet, ke markaz mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: However, the fusion process is taking place in the core of stars including our Sun.

blocks.prompt:
43 What is meant by an 'artificial Sun'?
('Artificial Sun' se kya muraad hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tajurbati fusion reactors, jaise China ke EAST aur HL-2M/HL-3, jo hydrogen isotopes ko 100 million °C se zyada garam kar ke Suraj jaisi fusion se saaf energy hasil karne ki koshish karte hain.

book_ref.quote: refers to experimental nuclear fusion reactors

blocks.prompt:
44 What is meant by the random nature of radioactive decay?
(Radioactive decay ke random hone ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hum nahi bata sakte ke koi khaas atom kab decay hoga; foran bhi ho sakta hai ya hazaron saal na ho. Sirf bohat bara sample aik tarteeb (pattern) par chalta hai. Decay curves ka utaar charhao is ka saboot hai.

book_ref.quote: This radioactive decay process is quite random

blocks.prompt:
45 Define activity and give its SI unit.
(Activity ki definition aur SI unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Activity radioactive maadde se har second nikalne wale particles ki tadaad hai. SI unit: becquerel (Bq); 1 Bq = 1 decay per second.

book_ref.quote: The activity of a radioactive substance is the number of particles it emits per second.

blocks.prompt:
46 What is count rate? How is it related to activity?
(Count rate kya hai? Is ka activity se kya taluq hai?)
blocks.explanation: Count rate radiation detector ke har second ke counts hain. Yeh source ki activity ke seedha mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: The count rate by a nuclear radiation detector is the number of counts recorded per second.

blocks.prompt:
47 Define half-life. Give two examples from the chapter.
(Half-life ki definition likhein. Chapter se do misalein dein.)
blocks.explanation: Half-life woh waqt hai jis mein sample ki activity kisi bhi ibtidai qeemat se aadhi ho jaye. Misalein: uranium-238, 4.5 × 10⁹ saal; radon, 3.8 din.

book_ref.quote: The time taken for the activity of a sample to decrease to half of any starting value is called half life.

blocks.prompt:
48 Why can a radioactive element never decay completely?
(Radioactive element kabhi poori tarah decay kyun nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Har half-life mein sirf aadhe baqi nuclei decay hote hain. Baqi N₀/2, N₀/4, N₀/8, … rehte hain jo kabhi zero nahi hote, is liye sab ke decay mein la-mehdood waqt chahiye.

book_ref.quote: firstly no radioactive element can completely decay

blocks.prompt:
49 Define decay constant and give its unit.
(Decay constant ki definition aur unit likhein.)
blocks.explanation: ΔN = −λNΔt mein λ decay constant hai: har unit time mein decay hone wale atoms ka hissa. Unit s⁻¹. Bara λ ho to diye gaye waqt mein zyada atoms decay hote hain.

book_ref.quote: is the constant of proportionality and is called decay constant

blocks.prompt:
50 Write the relation between activity and decay constant. Why is there no minus sign in it?
(Activity aur decay constant ka relation likhein. Is mein minus sign kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation: A = −ΔN/Δt = λN. Activity positive hai; ΔN = −λNΔt ka minus sign sirf batata hai ke N kam ho raha hai.

book_ref.quote: The activity is A = −ΔN/Δt = λN.

blocks.prompt:
51 A sample has 3.0 × 10¹⁷ undecayed nuclei and decay constant 5.0 × 10⁻⁸ s⁻¹. Find its activity.
(Aik sample mein 3.0 × 10¹⁷ undecayed nuclei aur decay constant 5.0 × 10⁻⁸ s⁻¹ hai. Activity nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: From Eq. 19.9 we can find activity:

blocks.prompt:
52 The decay constant of a radioisotope is 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ s⁻¹. Find its half-life in days.
(Aik radioisotope ka decay constant 1.0 × 10⁻⁶ s⁻¹ hai. Is ki half-life dinon mein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Thus, if the decay constant

blocks.prompt:
53 What fraction of a radioactive sample is left after 6 half-lives? What fraction has decayed?
(6 half-lives baad radioactive sample ka kitna hissa baqi rehta hai aur kitna decay ho chuka hota hai?)

book_ref.quote: the number of atoms left behind is(1 /2)ⁿ N₀

blocks.prompt:
54 A radioisotope has a half-life of 15 hours. Of 1600 atoms, how many are left and how many have decayed after 45 hours?
(Aik radioisotope ki half-life 15 ghante hai. 1600 atoms mein se 45 ghante baad kitne baqi aur kitne decay honge?)
blocks.explanation: 45 ghante = 3 half-lives. Baqi = 1600/8 = 200. Decay = 1600 − 200 = 1400.

book_ref.quote: If at any particular time the number of radioactive atoms be N

blocks.prompt:
55 What is a decay curve? What does it show?
(Decay curve kya hai? Yeh kya dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Decay curve undecayed atoms aur time ka graph hai. Yeh N₀ se shuru ho kar har half-life baad N₀/2, N₀/4, … tak girta hai, aur dikhata hai ke bara sample aik tarteeb se decay hota hai.

book_ref.quote: This graph shows that in the beginning, the number of atoms present in the sample

blocks.prompt:
56 What are artificial radioactive elements? How are they made?
(Artificial radioactive elements kya hain? Yeh kaise banaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stable element par bohat tez energy wale particles ki bombardment ki jati hai. Is se nuclei excite ho kar unstable aur radioactive ban jate hain. Inhein artificial radioactive elements kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Any stable element; besides the naturally occurring radioactive element, can be made radioactive.

blocks.prompt:
57 What is a radioactive tracer?
(Radioactive tracer kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radioactive isotope zinda jism mein aam isotope jaisa bartao karta hai, magar is ki radiation naap kar is ki jagah aur miqdaar maloom hoti hai. Is liye yeh tracer (nishandahi karne wala) ban kar kisi chemical ya biological amal ka peecha karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Thus, a radioactive isotope acts as an indicator or tracer

blocks.prompt:
58 Give two uses of radioisotopes in agriculture.
(Zaraat mein radioisotopes ke do istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Fertilizer mein thora radioisotope mila kar detector se pata chalta hai ke pauda kitna fertilizer leta hai. (2) Radiation se mutations kar ke chawal, chana, gandum aur kapas ki behtar, mazboot aur zyada paidawar wali iqsaam bani.

book_ref.quote: By mixing a small amount of radioactive isotope with fertilizer

blocks.prompt:
59 How are radioisotopes useful in chemistry and biology research?
(Chemistry aur biology ki research mein radioisotopes kaise kaam aate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh batate hain ke mushkil chemical reactions mein kya hota hai aur woh kaise aage barhti hain; biology mein paudon aur janwaron ki chemical reactions samajhne mein madad di hai.

book_ref.quote: Radioisotopes are used to find out what happens in many complex chemical reactions

blocks.prompt:
60 How is radioactive iodine used to check the thyroid gland?
(Radioactive iodine se thyroid gland kaise check kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Radio-iodine zyada tar thyroid gland mein jata hai. Kam activity ki thori dose de kar detector se dekha jata hai ke gland kitna leta hai; bimar ya hyperactive gland normal se do guna se zyada leta hai. Iodine-131 thyroid cancer ke ilaaj mein bhi istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: radioactive iodine can be used to check that a person's thyroid gland is working properly

blocks.prompt:
61 Which radioisotopes may be used for skin cancer, and why must the dose be controlled?
(Skin cancer ke liye kaunse radioisotopes istemal ho sakte hain aur dose qaboo mein kyun rakhni chahiye?)
blocks.explanation: Phosphorus-32 ya strontium-90. Dose ehtiyat se rakhni chahiye taake sehatmand tissues ko nuqsan na ho; mareez aksar is liye bimar mehsoos karte hain.

book_ref.quote: For skin cancer, phosphorous-32 or strontiun-90 may be used

blocks.prompt:
62 Name two organs that selectively absorb certain elements, and the element each absorbs.
(Do aise aaza (organs) batayein jo khaas elements jazb karte hain, aur har aik ka element.)
blocks.explanation: Thyroid gland iodine, haddiyan phosphorus aur jigar (liver) cobalt jazb karte hain; is liye in ke radioisotopes in aaza ke tracers ban sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: is absorbed mostly by the thyroid gland, phosphorus by bones and cobalt by liver

blocks.prompt:
63 What is annihilation of matter?
(Maadde ki annihilation kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab koi particle aur us ka antiparticle qareeb aate hain to dono khatam ho kar apna mass energy mein badal dete hain, maslan electron-positron pair se do γ-ray photons bante hain.

book_ref.quote: annihilation is an event taking place whenever a particle and its antiparticle come close to each other

blocks.prompt:
64 Why are two γ-ray photons, not one, produced when an electron-positron pair annihilates at rest?
(Saakin electron-positron pair ki annihilation par aik ki bajaye do γ-ray photons kyun bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Saakin pair ka kul momentum zero hai. Barabar energy (har aik 0.51 MeV) ke do photons mukhalif simt mein ja kar kul momentum zero rakhte hain, yani momentum mehfooz rehta hai.

book_ref.quote: Hence 2γ-ray photons will be emitted each with 0.51 MeV energy

blocks.prompt:
65 Find the energy of each photon when a proton (mass 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) and an antiproton of equal mass annihilate at rest into two photons (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).
(Proton (mass 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg) aur barabar mass ka antiproton saakin halat mein do photons mein annihilate hon to har photon ki energy nikalein (c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹).)
blocks.explanation: E = 2mc² = 3.01 × 10⁻¹⁰ J. Har photon: 1.51 × 10⁻¹⁰ J ≈ 941 MeV.

book_ref.quote: Using Einstein mass-energy relation E = 2mc²

blocks.prompt:
66 Why are particles collided at nearly the speed of light at CERN's Large Hadron Collider?
(CERN ke Large Hadron Collider mein particles ko roshni ki raftar ke qareeb kyun takraya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Elementary particles ki research ke liye bohat zyada energy chahiye. TeV ke darje ki energy par takrao ibtidai kainaat jaise halaat paida karta hai; isi kaam se July 2012 mein Higgs boson daryaft hua.

book_ref.quote: In elementary particles research, very high energies are required for investigations.
